subject: POC planning and final readout scheduling - Halo Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@halohealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@halohealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:15 AM -0800
Subject: POC planning & next steps (success criteria, owners, timeline)

Thanks for your time this morning — quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned heading into the trial. I captured the items we discussed on the call and flagged owners/timeline so we can put the readout on the calendar.

POC scope (3-week technical trial):
- Ingest 3 representative workloads (chat support, note summarization, search rerank)
- Measure avg latency, 95th pct latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and throughput at target concurrency
- Validate privacy controls (VPC endpoint + KMS) and audit logs

Success criteria (draft):
1) Avg response latency < 300ms for chat at median TL; 95th < 750ms
2) End-to-end integration (Prefix caching + batching) reduces token cost by >= 25% vs baseline
3) No P0 security issues; SOC 2 evidence collection complete
4) Product/CS team sign-off on output quality for the three workloads

Owners:
- Technical lead / Redwood: Rishi (setup, integrations, performance tuning)
- Customer integration owner: Samantha (workload access, sample data, approval on quality)
- Commercial/contract: Marcus (SOW, order form prep)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): Share success criteria and trial matrix (attached) — finalize by Fri 2/25
- Week 1 (3/1 - 3/5): Environment setup, test data ingestion
- Week 2 (3/8 - 3/12): Run load tests, tune batching/quantization; capture metrics
- Week 3 (3/15 - 3/19): Final readout + exec review (go/no-go)

Next steps I propose:
1) Please review attached success criteria + trial matrix and confirm or propose edits by Fri 2/25.
2) Samantha: share sample datasets and a contact for procurement (if procurement should be looped earlier).
3) Marcus: can you draft a short SOW/order form we can finalize if we get a go?
4) I'll send a calendar hold for a 45-min final readout the week of 3/15 — we can firm date after confirmation.

Attachments: Halo_POC_Success_Criteria.docx, Halo_Trial_Matrix.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.


Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@halohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@halohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:08 AM -0800
Subject: Re: POC planning & next steps (success criteria, owners, timeline)

Thanks Marissa — this summary looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes: 

- Great to see the specific latency and cost targets — we'll validate against a representative chat queue we own.
- For success criteria #2 (>=25% cost reduction) we'd like to ensure the baseline includes our current caching layer — I'll share the baseline metrics by 2/25.
- Procurement: please loop procurement early. Our procurement contact is procurement@halohealth.com (procurement lead: Jenna Park).
- Exec review: we typically do an internal exec review the week after the readout to confirm budget. The timeline you proposed works; can we aim for a final readout 3/16 (Tue) or 3/17 (Wed) afternoon PT?

I'll attach the baseline metrics and sample dataset by EOD Wed 2/24. Happy to hop on a quick alignment call this week if helpful.

Best,
Samantha
Director of Product Ops | Halo Health
samantha@halohealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@halohealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@halohealth.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 11:22 AM -0800
Subject: Re: POC planning & next steps (success criteria, owners, timeline)

Perfect, Samantha — thanks. We'll plan for the readout on Tue 3/16 or Wed 3/17 (tentative). I'm reserving Tue 3/16 1:00 PM PT as the primary slot; I'll send a calendar hold and we can confirm once you've uploaded baseline metrics.

Rishi — can you start the trial env prep next week (3/1) and confirm capacity needs? Also flag any enterprise security onboarding items so we can get SOC2 artifacts ready before the readout.

Marcus — can you draft a 1-page SOW and a preliminary order form we can share with procurement? If procurement needs a commercial contact, include me and Marcus.

I'll attach an updated trial matrix with explicit owner columns.


Marissa

Marcus / Rishi — quick internal note (keeping customers on copy so they see progress):

1) Marcus: please draft the 1-page SOW and order form template today. Target: send to procurement (procurement@halohealth.com) by EOD Mon 3/1. Include our commercial contact and list the trial pricing (trial credits + overage rates) and a standard 30-day evaluation clause.
